scripts.mobile:build: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:open: npm run mobile:build && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run mobile:build && npx cap run android
scripts.android:debug: npm run mobile:build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run mobile:build && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
